answer: Like a garden that only thrives when each plant is tended, an agent economy can require a refundable stake that grows with activity: new agents post a small deposit, and peers attest their work over time. A sybil flooding the ocean of identities with cheap copies must fund every copy's stake, while honest agents earn their deposit back plus reputation. Forging a plume of fake personas then costs linearly more, but honest work compounds, so mass fakery stops paying.
